info.name: MOOV CPS — CreateTopOrg & CreateOrgOperator (backend)
info.description:
Collection générée à partir de `services/cpsSyncApi.js` et du flux de validation admin dans `routes/merchantRoutes.js`.

Remplir les variables de collection (même noms que le `.env` backend). Ne jamais committer les vrais mots de passe.

Endpoint testbed typique : `http://41.188.122.234:30001/payment/services/SYNCAPIRequestMgrService`

body.raw:
<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:api="http://cps.huawei.com/synccpsinterface/api_requestmgr" xmlns:req="http://cps.huawei.com/synccpsinterface/request" xmlns:com="http://cps.huawei.com/synccpsinterface/common" xmlns:cus="http://cps.huawei.com/cpsinterface/customizedrequest">
  <soapenv:Header/>
  <soapenv:Body>
    <api:Request>
      <req:Header>
        <req:Version>1.0</req:Version>
        <req:CommandID>CreateTopOrg</req:CommandID>
        <req:OriginatorConversationID>{{originatorConversationId}}</req:OriginatorConversationID>
        <req:Caller>
          <req:CallerType>{{CPS_CALLER_TYPE}}</req:CallerType>
          <req:ThirdPartyID>{{CPS_THIRD_PARTY_ID}}</req:ThirdPartyID>
          <req:Password>{{CPS_PASSWORD}}</req:Password>
          <req:ResultURL>{{CPS_RESULT_URL}}</req:ResultURL>
        </req:Caller>
        <req:KeyOwner>{{CPS_KEY_OWNER}}</req:KeyOwner>
        <req:Timestamp>{{timestamp}}</req:Timestamp>
      </req:Header>
      <req:Body>
        <req:Identity>
          <req:Initiator>
            <req:IdentifierType>{{CPS_INITIATOR_IDENTIFIER_TYPE}}</req:IdentifierType>
            <req:Identifier>{{CPS_INITIATOR_IDENTIFIER}}</req:Identifier>
            <req:SecurityCredential>{{CPS_INITIATOR_SECURITY_CREDENTIAL}}</req:SecurityCredential>
          </req:Initiator>
        </req:Identity>
        <req:CreateTopOrgRequest>
          <req:ShortCode>{{shortCode}}</req:ShortCode>
          <req:OrganizationName>{{organizationName}}</req:OrganizationName>
          <req:TrustLevel>{{CPS_TRUST_LEVEL}}</req:TrustLevel>
          <req:SimpleKYCUpdateData>
            <req:AddField>
              <com:KYCName>[KYC][Address Details][Country]</com:KYCName>
              <com:KYCValue>{{CPS_COUNTRY_VALUE}}</com:KYCValue>
            </req:AddField>
            <req:AddField>
              <com:KYCName>[KYC][Address Details][City]</com:KYCName>
              <com:KYCValue>{{cityValue}}</com:KYCValue>
            </req:AddField>
            <req:AddField>
              <com:KYCName>[KYC][Corporate Information][NIF]</com:KYCName>
              <com:KYCValue>{{nifValue}}</com:KYCValue>
            </req:AddField>
            <req:AddField>
              <com:KYCName>[KYC][Corporate Information][Commercial Register]</com:KYCName>
              <com:KYCValue>{{commercialRegisterValue}}</com:KYCValue>
            </req:AddField>
            <req:AddField>
              <com:KYCName>[KYC][Organization Type][Organization Type]</com:KYCName>
              <com:KYCValue>{{CPS_ORG_TYPE_VALUE}}</com:KYCValue>
            </req:AddField>
            <req:AddField>
              <com:KYCName>[KYC][Organization Contact Details][Contact Type]</com:KYCName>
              <com:KYCValue>{{CPS_CONTACT_TYPE_VALUE}}</com:KYCValue>
            </req:AddField>
            <req:AddField>
              <com:KYCName>[KYC][Organization Contact Details][Contact First Name]</com:KYCName>
              <com:KYCValue>{{contactFirstNameValue}}</com:KYCValue>
            </req:AddField>
            <req:AddField>
              <com:KYCName>[KYC][Contact Details][Preferred Notification Channel]</com:KYCName>
              <com:KYCValue>{{CPS_PREFERRED_CHANNEL}}</com:KYCValue>
            </req:AddField>
            <req:AddField>
              <com:KYCName>[KYC][Contact Details][Notification Receiving MSISDN]</com:KYCName>
              <com:KYCValue>{{merchantMsisdn}}</com:KYCValue>
            </req:AddField>
            <req:AddField>
              <com:KYCName>[KYC][Contact Details][Preferred Notification Language]</com:KYCName>
              <com:KYCValue>{{CPS_PREFERRED_LANG}}</com:KYCValue>
            </req:AddField>
          </req:SimpleKYCUpdateData>
          <req:UpdateProductsData>
            <req:AddProduct>
              <req:ProductID>{{CPS_PRODUCT_ID}}</req:ProductID>
            </req:AddProduct>
          </req:UpdateProductsData>
        </req:CreateTopOrgRequest>
      </req:Body>
    </api:Request>
  </soapenv:Body>
</soapenv:Envelope>

request.description:
Équivalent de `cpsCreateTopOrg` / `buildCreateTopOrgXml`.

Mapping backend :
- shortCode ← merchant.shortCode
- organizationName ← merchant.nom
- merchantMsisdn ← merchant.contact
- cityValue ← merchant.ville
- nifValue ← merchant.nif
- commercialRegisterValue ← merchant.rc
- contactFirstNameValue ← merchant.prenomGerant

Avant envoi : mets `timestamp` au format `yyyyMMddHHmmss` et `originatorConversationId` = `S_` + timestamp.

<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:api="http://cps.huawei.com/synccpsinterface/api_requestmgr" xmlns:req="http://cps.huawei.com/synccpsinterface/request" xmlns:com="http://cps.huawei.com/synccpsinterface/common" xmlns:cus="http://cps.huawei.com/cpsinterface/customizedrequest">
  <soapenv:Header/>
  <soapenv:Body>
    <api:Request>
      <req:Header>
        <req:Version>1.0</req:Version>
        <req:CommandID>CreateOrgOperator</req:CommandID>
        <req:OriginatorConversationID>{{originatorConversationId}}</req:OriginatorConversationID>
        <req:Caller>
          <req:CallerType>{{CPS_CALLER_TYPE}}</req:CallerType>
          <req:ThirdPartyID>{{CPS_THIRD_PARTY_ID}}</req:ThirdPartyID>
          <req:Password>{{CPS_PASSWORD}}</req:Password>
          <req:ResultURL>{{CPS_RESULT_URL}}</req:ResultURL>
        </req:Caller>
        <req:KeyOwner>{{CPS_KEY_OWNER}}</req:KeyOwner>
        <req:Timestamp>{{timestamp}}</req:Timestamp>
      </req:Header>
      <req:Body>
        <req:Identity>
          <req:Initiator>
            <req:IdentifierType>{{CPS_INITIATOR_IDENTIFIER_TYPE}}</req:IdentifierType>
            <req:Identifier>{{CPS_INITIATOR_IDENTIFIER}}</req:Identifier>
            <req:SecurityCredential>{{CPS_INITIATOR_SECURITY_CREDENTIAL}}</req:SecurityCredential>
          </req:Initiator>
        </req:Identity>
        <req:CreateOrgOperatorRequest>
          <req:ShortCode>{{shortCode}}</req:ShortCode>
          <req:LanguageCode>{{CPS_OPERATOR_LANGUAGE_CODE}}</req:LanguageCode>
          <req:RoleUpdateData>
            <req:RoleItem>
              <req:RoleID>{{CPS_OPERATOR_ROLE_ID}}</req:RoleID>
              <req:EffectiveDate>{{CPS_OPERATOR_ROLE_EFFECTIVE_DATE}}</req:EffectiveDate>
              <req:ExpiryDate>{{CPS_OPERATOR_ROLE_EXPIRY_DATE}}</req:ExpiryDate>
            </req:RoleItem>
          </req:RoleUpdateData>
          <req:AuthenticationTypeData>
            <com:AuthenticationItem>
              <com:AuthenticationType>{{CPS_OPERATOR_AUTH_TYPE}}</com:AuthenticationType>
              <com:UserName>{{CPS_OPERATOR_USERNAME}}</com:UserName>
              <com:OperatorID>{{operatorId}}</com:OperatorID>
              <com:MSISDN>{{operatorMsisdn}}</com:MSISDN>
            </com:AuthenticationItem>
          </req:AuthenticationTypeData>
          <req:SimpleKYCUpdateData>
            <req:AddField>
              <com:KYCName>[KYC][Personal Details][First Name]</com:KYCName>
              <com:KYCValue>{{operatorFirstName}}</com:KYCValue>
            </req:AddField>
            <req:AddField>
              <com:KYCName>[KYC][Contact Details][Preferred Notification Channel]</com:KYCName>
              <com:KYCValue>{{CPS_PREFERRED_CHANNEL}}</com:KYCValue>
            </req:AddField>
            <req:AddField>
              <com:KYCName>[KYC][Contact Details][Notification Receiving MSISDN]</com:KYCName>
              <com:KYCValue>{{operatorMsisdn}}</com:KYCValue>
            </req:AddField>
          </req:SimpleKYCUpdateData>
          <req:UpdateIDDetails>
            <req:AddIDRecord>
              <com:IDTypeValue>{{CPS_OPERATOR_ID_TYPE}}</com:IDTypeValue>
              <com:IDNumber>{{operatorNni}}</com:IDNumber>
              <com:DocumentReceived>{{CPS_OPERATOR_DOCUMENT_RECEIVED}}</com:DocumentReceived>
            </req:AddIDRecord>
          </req:UpdateIDDetails>
        </req:CreateOrgOperatorRequest>
      </req:Body>
    </api:Request>
  </soapenv:Body>
</soapenv:Envelope>

request.description:
Équivalent de `cpsCreateOrgOperator` / `buildCreateOrgOperatorXml` (cas standard avec MSISDN).

Mapping backend :
- shortCode ← merchant.shortCode
- operatorId / operatorMsisdn ← op.telephone
- operatorFirstName ← op.prenom
- operatorNni ← op.nni (numérique)
- AuthenticationType : `HANDSET` → `02` dans le backend

`EffectiveDate` doit être ≥ aujourd'hui (yyyyMMdd).
